purpose: Adapters for 07E India, Latin America, NHM palaeontology and Smithsonian palynology expansion.
guards: Preserve dated collection counts and source-level count scope.
Do not infer slide totals from locality, species, specimen, card or legacy-object totals unless the source explicitly links one record to one slide.
Keep petrographic thin sections, palynological preparations, nannofossil slides and biological whole mounts as distinct preparation types.

adapters.promotion_rule: Capture the 12,740 slide total independently of type specimens and negatives; preserve gift/exchange and teaching-gift language.
Preserve BA Pal and earlier acronym layers, founder/contributor names, slide count and type count separately.
Separate microscopic preparations, pinned specimens and type counts; preserve Ogloblin/De Santis contribution context.

adapters.institution_scope: Museo Nacional de Historia Natural Santiago
adapters.target: government research report creating SGOpm preparations
adapters.promotion_rule: Treat 50 as species scope, not slide count; capture transfer of project preparations into the SGOpm collection.

adapters.target: Ted Kellock geological thin section collection page
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture hand-specimen/slide pairing, maker-preparer role and Quekett catalogue project; classify as petrographic thin sections.
Keep former BP fossil palynology and modern 2013 reference collection as separate survey nodes despite sharing one page.
Capture the bounded ODP/DSDP reference slide collection separately from former BP holdings.

adapters.target: Tropical Paleoecology Lab PollenGEO collection descriptions
adapters.promotion_rule: Preserve named source collections and explicit card-to-slide association; do not merge species/taxon totals into slide totals.
Enumerate database records only within the bounded palynological collection and preserve source herbarium, locality and preparation method.

adapters.institution_scope: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History
adapters.promotion_rule: Store 70,000 as slide count; keep the much larger number of individual pollen specimens per slide as a separate multiplicity concept.

adapters.target: Tainacan-style Colecao Laminas and linked records
adapters.promotion_rule: Enumerate only records belonging to the thin-section collection; do not borrow counts from related hand-specimen collections.
